name: Netherlands
standard: EN 301 549 with WCAG 2.1 A+AA ('Digitoegankelijk' open standard)

laws.summary: Government bodies must make websites and apps meet EN 301 549 and publish an accessibility statement.
Legal basis for the Besluit since 2023-07-01 (it replaced the 'Tijdelijk' decree of 2018-07-01).

applies_to: Public sector bodies (central government, provinces, municipalities, water boards, bodies governed by public law): websites, mobile apps, intranets, extranets and cloud apps.

deadlines.what: Besluit re-based on the Wdo ('Tijdelijk' dropped)

exceptions: Disproportionate burden (onevenredige last), explained in the statement with an accessible alternative
requires: Publish an accessibility statement in the national register (status A–E)
Keep improving, with an annual update
mobile: explicit — apps are named in scope.
procurement: Digitoegankelijk is on Forum Standaardisatie's 'pas toe of leg uit' (comply-or-explain) list for government procurement.
enforcement: Logius checks the statements in the register; the Ministry of BZK reports annually to Parliament and every 3 years to the Commission. Dedicated supervision is described as 'work underway'.
notes: The BWBR id, Wdo re-basing and monitoring details come from search-result summaries of wetten.overheid.nl and digitoegankelijk.nl. The comply-or-explain listing comes from a Forum Standaardisatie search result. No independent enforcement authority with fines was confirmed.
